p: A Japanese human resources team of three, a woman and a man in navy business suits and a woman in a light blue blouse, standing together around a tablet showing blank plain bars, smiling, with a friendly plain white speech bubble character with a face floating beside them.

A tired HR staff member in a navy business suit at a desk, searching through tall stacks of blank binders and folders while several blank speech balloons from colleagues pile up around them, looking weary.
A woman in a navy business suit at a desk writing on a blank document on a laptop, with a friendly plain white speech bubble character with a face next to her, handing her a neat blank page draft.
A busy man in a navy business suit at a desk, copying between a paper stack of blank forms and a blank spreadsheet on a monitor, while blank paper forms keep arriving on a tray, looking rushed.

A woman HR staff member in a navy business suit at a desk, reviewing one tidy blank job description sheet. Next to her floats a friendly plain white speech bubble character with a face. The speech bubble character is only a white bubble with a small face: it has no body, no human torso, no suit, no tie and no clothes. It hovers beside a blank envelope.

A calm job interview seen from the side: one candidate in a navy business suit sitting on a chair on the left, and a man and a woman interviewer in navy business suits sitting on visible blue office chairs on the right, with a simple table between them. On a separate small side table, a small friendly plain white speech bubble character with a face, only a white bubble with no body, tidies blank notes into two neat stacks.

A new employee in a navy business suit welcomed at the center, while blank task cards flow out along simple lines to three small desks: a laptop, a box of office supplies, and a blank training book, all connected in a neat flow.

A young new employee in a navy business suit asking a question at a laptop, and a friendly plain white speech bubble character with a face pointing to an open blank rule book and a blank document with a bookmark.

A woman trainer in a navy business suit checking a blank slide on a large screen and a blank quiz sheet with empty checkboxes, with a friendly plain white speech bubble character with a face holding an open blank manual.

A man HR staff member in a navy business suit looking at a tidy blank attendance list on a laptop, with blank envelopes flying out to a few employees sitting at a small training room with blank desks.

A young employee in a navy business suit sitting relaxed and thinking at a laptop, talking with a friendly plain white speech bubble character with a face, with a simple path of steps rising toward a small flag and a blank book beside it.

A woman employee in a navy business suit using a smartphone with a blank form, a line leading to a manager man giving a thumbs up at a desk, then to a blank wall calendar without characters with one amber highlighted square.

A woman HR staff member in a navy business suit looking at simple blank bar charts on a monitor, with many anonymous blank paper survey sheets gathered into one neat tray, and a small closed padlock icon beside the tray.

Two colleagues in navy business suits, a man and a woman, handing over a neat blank folder at a desk, with a cardboard box containing a laptop and a blank ID card on the desk, and a friendly plain white speech bubble character with a face holding a tidy blank checklist.
